## Level-Up Flow

**Offered when:** `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` and `level < 10` (thresholds: 0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000). Worker computes `shouldLevelUp()` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`), returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve`. Frontend shows a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) + ability picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`).

**Endpoint:** Player picks an ability → `game-console.component.ts:183 levelUp(key)` → `GameApiService.levelUp()` → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`), body includes `sessionId`, `characterId`, `abilityChoice` (str/dex/con/int/wis/cha). Rejects if `!shouldLevelUp` (400) or invalid ability.

**Character changes** (`services/character.ts:133 levelUp`):
- `level += 1`
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON modifier`, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- **+2** to the chosen ability score (no cap at 20; AC unchanged)
- Worker logs a `[Level Up]` system message + DM history turn, generates flavor narrative (usually fallback text — known bug B-03)
- Frontend then calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows system message

Only one level processed per call — a character with enough XP for two levels must call `/api/levelup` twice.
